title: Lamp Oil
summary: Pim Rushlight knows what burns, and the lock-keepers' oil stores under the Canal Locks burn better than anything he sells. Hold eight waves there, and he'll show your mages how to keep a fire off somebody (the mage's level-12 skill).

steps.journal: Hold eight waves in the Canal Locks, among the lock-keepers' stores. Any floor will do.

objectives.label: Waves held at the Canal Locks

ready: Go back to Pim Rushlight, at his handcart by Saltmere's cistern.
done: Pim taught your mages Arcane Ward. He charged nothing, and told you so three times.
